Your experience section should highlight not just what you did, but how your work created value. Keep each role focused, relevant, and results-driven.
Summarize your key responsibilities in 2–3 impactful sentences.
Emphasize achievements that align with the role you’re applying for.
Focus on outcomes rather than daily duties.
Quantify your results whenever possible — numbers immediately build credibility and attract attention.
Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z].
Example: “Boosted sales by 20% through a new client engagement strategy.”
Include metrics such as time saved, growth achieved, or efficiency improved.
